capabilities: Parse DevOps config files (Docker, Terraform, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
Watch a chosen folder and re-parse files on change
Generate Markdown documentation from parsed files using AI providers
Import file types Obsidian does not natively support
Validate AI provider API keys with a test connection command
disambiguation: Not a tool for running or managing infrastructure; it only parses DevOps config files and generates documentation from them.
extras: Alpha-stage plugin under active development; installation is developer-mode only (clone repo and build with Node.js/npm), no marketplace release mentioned.
motivation: Created by Jobelin Kom – bringing DevOps into your second brain.
problem: Obsidian does not natively support files like .tf and .yml, and infrastructure configuration usually lacks clear documentation inside the vault.

relations.evidence: 🧩 Google Gemini | Free API access via Google AI Studio
🪶 Anthropic Claude | High-context reasoning for documentation
⚡ Mistral AI | Lightweight, fast, and privacy-focused

requires.name: OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or Mistral API key

summary: AI-assisted plugin that scans DevOps config files (Docker, Terraform, CI/CD) in a vault folder and generates structured Markdown documentation.
